title: Fix Norwegian SAF-T 1.30 export issues
summary: Norwegian SAF-T 1.30 export now correctly reports header versions, handles credit amounts as non-negative, excludes unselected dimensions from the XML, and counts transaction groups consistently across split files.
key_points: Header versions are now set to 1.30 and the current application version instead of hardcoded values
Credit currency amounts are exported as non-negative values rather than retaining their sign
Analysis data for dimensions not selected for export is omitted from the XML
Transaction count uses exported transaction groups across journals and repeats totals in every split file
SAF-T 1.20 exports remain unchanged; comprehensive XML regression tests added
quote: Norwegian SAF-T 1.30 exports can contain wrong header versions, negative credit amounts, unwanted dimensions and inconsistent transaction totals.
